note: v2: the drift gets a shape (ground F Eb Db C, Risset pendulum, build)
v4: the hold an eighth apart on Ab, built on the eighth (hat eighths, ghost echo, bass on both guitars)
v6: the hold three sixteenths apart on B, the band only on the five coincidences
v8: the hold a sixteenth apart on C, kick and bass on every note of either guitar, the drummer in the three holes
v9: the right guitar chugs join with the bass and kick at bar 4; the band stops for the voice first word
v10: two clocks at the end, left and right, in opposition (and the snare out of the cymbals room, whole song)
v11: the letting go at bar 74: a fill, one last hit, the guitars and bass hold the open F and die under the clean ticks
v12: the heavy chugs lock half a bar apart two bars before the landing; the bass pedal swells
v16: bars 42-44 of the eighth hold, the two guitars alone (the echo), then a crash
v18: a heartbeat under the drift (bass eighths, hat, soft kick from bar 78); the lock shaken at bars 106-110
v19: the four in-step lines are sung on the riff notes, doubled quietly each side, in the guitars room, at the records voice level (was spoken, on top)
v20: the hold on B builds (china joins at 1:56) and ends in one bar where the guitars too play only the five hits (2:02)
v24: over the eighth hold's last four bars (44-48, 1:38-1:46) two music boxes play the hook, the right one on the right guitar's clock: each note chimes right then left an eighth apart
v26: in step, bar 12 the left guitar alone, bar 13 the right alone (0:27-0:31), then both into the stop and the voice
